status_definitions.launch_candidate: Tier 1 source target; intended for launch after operational/content validation

status_definitions.phase_3_validation: outer/extended territory; dispatch/service coverage must be confirmed first
status_definitions.research_only: landmark/corridor or weak standalone-location intent; do not auto-publish
status_definitions.manual_review: source term, alias, or geography needs verification before use

matrix_definitions.full: eligible for the primary matrix once service availability is confirmed
matrix_definitions.selective: create only high-value combinations with distinct intent/content
matrix_definitions.conditional: hold until service coverage and demand are validated
matrix_definitions.hold: do not generate matrix pages by default
